lines.text: Montepulciano is a town, not a grape.
lines.phonemes: mˌɔntepultʃˈɑːnoʊ ɪz ɐ tˈaʊn, nˌɑːɾə ɡɹˈeɪp.
dˌiː ˌoʊ sˌiː dʒˈiː sˈɪns nˈaɪntiːn ˈeɪɾi.

lines.text: About fourteen hundred hectares of vines.
lines.phonemes: ɐbˌaʊt fˈɔːɹtiːn hˈʌndɹɪd hˈɛktɛɹz ʌv vˈaɪnz.

lines.text: Seventy percent Sangiovese, called Prugnolo Gentile.
lines.phonemes: sˈɛvənti pɚsˈɛnt sˌændʒoʊvˈeɪzeɪ, kˈɔːld pɹuɲˈɔːloʊ dʒentˈiːleɪ.

lines.text: Twelve Pieve areas, eighty-five percent minimum.
lines.phonemes: twˈɛlv pjˈɛːveɪ ˈɛɹiəz, ˈeɪɾifˈaɪv pɚsˈɛnt mˈɪnɪməm.

lines.text: Three hundred thirty metres on average, with vines up to six hundred.
lines.phonemes: θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi mˈiːɾɚz ˌɔn ˈævɹɪdʒ, wɪð vˈaɪnz ˌʌp tə sˈɪks hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Mostly limestone, marl and dolomite bedrock.
lines.phonemes: mˈoʊstli lˈaɪmstoʊn, mˈɑːɹl ænd dˈɑːləmˌaɪt bˈɛdɹɑːk.

lines.text: Eight hundred twenty-three millimetres a year at Siena. July is the driest month.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪt hˈʌndɹɪd twˈɛntiθɹˈiː mˈɪlɪmˌiːɾɚz ɐ jˈɪɹ æt siˈɛnə. dʒuːlˈaɪ ɪz ðə dɹˈaɪəst mˈʌnθ.

lines.text: April to October averages nineteen point three degrees. August days reach almost thirty-one.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪpɹəl tʊ ɑːktˈoʊbɚɹ ˈævɹɪdʒᵻz nˈaɪntiːn pˈɔɪnt θɹˈiː dᵻɡɹˈiːz. ˈɔːɡəst dˈeɪz ɹˈiːtʃ ˈɔːlmoʊst θˈɜːɾiwˌʌn.

lines.text: Test yourself. Three questions. Answers in the first comment.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛst jɔːɹsˈɛlf. θɹˈiː kwˈɛstʃənz. ˈænsɚz ɪnðə fˈɜːst kˈɑːmɛnt.

lines.text: Study it free at open wine atlas dot com.
lines.phonemes: stˈʌdi ɪt fɹˈiː æɾ ˈoʊpən wˈaɪn ˈætləs dˈɑːt kˈɑːm.
